news.title: WashU builds momentum through AI initiative
news.summary_en: As the fall semester approaches, WashU’s AI initiative is driving academic innovation across schools and disciplines.

news.title: WashU’s mascot finally has a name: Meet Forest
news.summary_en: After 101 years, the WashU bear now has a name: Forest. The new name comes with a new spirit. “Forest is really curious, really creative, a little silly and a little sly, so watch out,” says Anna Gonzalez, vice chancellor for student success.

news.title: Scientists identify brain’s brake that shuts off chronic pain
news.summary_en: WashU Medicine researchers have found that certain receptors on a cluster of nerve cells can shut off chronic pain. The study opens new doors for developing pain therapies.

news.title: Why WashU’s newest students chose St. Louis
news.summary_en: The 1,945 students in the WashU Class of 2030 moved onto the South 40 last week. The new Bears, arriving from 29 countries and every region in the U.S., are excited to explore St. Louis’ neighborhoods, food and landmarks.
